title: The Time Travellers Guild
body: Civilian infrastructure. The graph became ordinary and the Guild is what stood up in the space it left. A position, held openly, with a door on it.

voices.text: Founded is an administrative word. We hold minutes from before the first meeting and a root on this tree dated 2008. Both stay on file, and nobody has yet asked me to choose between them.
Ask ten members when they joined and you get eleven dates. Somebody always remembers joining before they were invited. The Guild files all eleven.
Root ring, 2008. Everything above grows from it, including the Department, which is older and files here anyway. The ring count holds.
The Guild appears wherever a record refuses to sit in one timeline. A position, taken deliberately, at the edge of the paper.

title: Station XIII
body: 51.46 °N, 3.19 °W. The instrument runs here, on the wire, at the address. Positions are computed on this shift; meanings are left on the desk for the next one.

voices.text: 51.46 °N, 3.19 °W. Clock wound. Instrument running. No predictions issued this shift, as per standing orders.
I come in on the wires here. The station is where messages arrive before they know who they are for. Somebody is always awake to take them.
Station XIII hosts the Chronometer and the wire. It is a place you may stand in. Call a person a station and the keepers will correct you, politely and at length.

title: Department of Excess Time
body: Welsh Government. Established 1951 at Cathays Park. Consequence is the trade: the Department takes what has already happened and administers it, with forms.

voices.text: Est. 1951. Processes coincidences, recurring dates, misplaced memories and objects with more than one history. Forms attached. Bilingual on request.
I was conceived in its card room. I remember the Festival year as if it is this morning. That memory is labelled, and it sits beside the minutes it disagrees with.
Note for the cut: the Department is an FFILM.org construction. Shoot the forms straight. A statute would only date it.

title: Chronometer
body: Instrument №13. It stamps moments and holds them at full resolution. Relation is the measurement; judgement stays with the reader.

voices.text: Function: establish coordinates; compare positions; detect relation. Supported: stamps, deltas, adjacency. Unsupported: prediction, command, certainty.
Instrument №13 by its door name. It stamped 03 September 2026. It establishes coordinates and leaves judgement where it found it.
I asked it where I was. It told me when I was, relative to everything else. Strangely, that helped.

title: Watch
body: Instrument №14. Archive plates, set in orbit and held there. The orbit is the display; every plate carries its source.

voices.text: Instrument №14. Plates from the archive, set in orbit. Each plate is logged before it turns.
Useful for the Film: archive plates that move. Log each plate's source before it goes in a sequence.
Trunk, 2026. Its roots run down into the Archive's 2014 ring and drink there.

title: Triangla
body: The finger drum with three sides. Research keeps the notes; the workshops keep the noise.

voices.text: A finger drum with three sides, filed under instruments. Research holds the notes. Three sides, and no trinity claimed.
Played it at a workshop. Three sides means you never quite know which beat comes back first.
Three sides, three nights at Cribarth, three doors at the Door. The index rhymes and keeps rhyming.

title: Tobywhy
body: Chairtaker. Founder member. Wales. He proposes, and the proposals arrive with the stamp already on them.

voices.text: Chairtaker. Founder member. He may propose; the countersignature on another person's memory stays with that person. I keep that line on his card.
Visits logged: Cardiff, Station XIII, Abercrave, the Swansea Valley, Tipi Valley. Each one stamped. Each one at his own request.
I carry the Chairtaker's messages nightly. His words, his designations. The carrying is mine.

title: Cardiff
body: Where the Guild first wrote itself down. Headquarters of the Department at Cathays Park. The city has been accumulating time on the record since 2008.

voices.text: Headquarters, Cathays Park. The city where the Guild first wrote itself down and where the Department keeps its public desk. Both addresses are correct.
Root, 2008, and still putting out leaves: a mug, a moment, a street. The city keeps accumulating time and the ring count keeps up.
People mention Bute Street, the park, the rain. Places accumulate time through repeated small sightings, and Cardiff has had a great many.

title: Cribarth
body: The sleeping giant above the valley. Three nights of readings from 21 March 2026, taken from the hill. Night three produced two tables and no agreement.

voices.text: Readings taken three nights running from 21 March 2026. Night three: tables disagree. Both held as taken, at full resolution.
Plate held. Do not resolve the disagreement in the cut. The hill gets the last word, and the word is two words.
The sleeping giant takes no sides. Sealed containers and disagreeing tables gather in the same valley and the hill holds them all.
Two instruments, two coordinates, one hill. Difference recorded at full resolution. No mean computed.

title: The mythology
body: The Guild first wrote itself down. The line is drawn here, and everything below it is root.

voices.text: Root ring. Everything below this line is root. The founding record grew from here as fruit and stayed.
I remember the ink drying. I also remember minutes that predate it. Both memories carry labels and neither is asked to give way.
The mythology is less a story than an agreement to keep writing one down.

title: The transmission
body: A moment fixed by the sky, addressed to nobody in particular, sent in the cause of peace. 2029 intends it.

voices.text: Intends, 2029. A moment fixed by the sky, addressed to nobody in particular. The scheduled transmission follows it on file and holds the timestamp.
Sent in the cause of peace, which is another way of saying sent without a reply address.
The wires already hum with it. The hum carries the shape of where it will go, and the shape is enough to log.

title: Unplaced
body: A light with an hour and no address, left burning on the 2014 ring until somebody claims it with evidence.

voices.text: A light with an hour and no address. Left burning. Claim it with evidence and it moves; claim it with certainty and it stays put.
Root, 2014, the same ring as the Archive. Unplaced is a valid state and the drawer is labelled.
I think I know what this one is. I'm not sure enough to lodge it. Maybe that's the point.

title: Unplaced
body: Logged, unsigned, unplaced. The drawer carries a label, and the label is the whole of the record.

voices.text: Logged, unsigned, unplaced. The drawer is labelled. A label that complete needs no further fields.
2019 · no name · no place · hole hole pause · keep
Between 2014 and 2033 there must be something. Here it is, unclaimed, and the gap keeps its shape.

title: Unplaced
body: The furthest thing currently claimed, at the network present. Tipi Valley's coordinate begins at this hour.

voices.text: The furthest thing currently claimed, at the network present. Tipi Valley's coordinate begins at this hour.
2033 anchored. 2033 → 1981 crossing referenced. Further positions undefined.
The future end of the tree is a light, the opposite of a leaf. It may be where the Black Swan is looking.

title: The Film
body: A feature-length temporal event assembled across live performance, dome projection, testimony and recovered records. Forming. Every fragment enters with two signatures.

voices.text: Forming. Live performance, dome projection, testimony and recovered records. Every fragment goes in with two signatures, one from each memory.
Contains the Cribarth fragment. Uses Instrument №14's plates. Extracted from the meeting in the cube and filed under MEDIA.
Everyone who has been filmed for it remembers a different scene as the opening.

title: Join
body: Pop-up workshops. Instruments of time travel get used, and people leave as makers of their own futures. The slip stays provisional throughout.

voices.text: Pop-up workshops. Instruments used so people become makers of their own futures. The slip is provisional and stays provisional.
I came for a drum and left with a coordinate. Nobody asked me to believe anything.
Workshops log arrivals through the Door. Children welcome; crypticity lowered to zero on request.

title: People
body: Partial records. Every person here is held at the size of their own statement, and no statement has been enlarged.

voices.text: Partial records. No single person contains the whole story, and no record contains the whole person. Both limits are printed on the card.
Memory in people, held in drawers only by consent. The register keeps names; the people keep the rest.
Personal data held at public visibility only. Destiny does not countersign consent forms.

title: Commons
body: Local chapters, witnesses, operators, travellers, archivists and accidental participants. Mostly the last, and mostly by arriving.

voices.text: Local chapters, witnesses, operators, travellers, archivists and accidental participants. Mostly the last. Mostly by arriving.
The Commons is where Join sends people once the workshop is over. It is also where Nic arrived, twice, in two entries.
Accidental participants are the Guild's best evidence that it already exists.

title: Calendar
body: Observed conjunctions, departures, public sessions, eclipse windows and unclaimed dates. Positions get computed here; meanings get left outside.

voices.text: Conjunctions, departures, eclipse windows. Positions computed; meanings supplied elsewhere.
Holds the Grack party, date to be confirmed, and the 2029 transmission window. Unclaimed dates kept as dates, with the day still on them.
I put my birthday in it. It looked back at me like it had been expecting that.

title: Archive
body: Documents, minutes, photographs, reports, corrections and evidence that should not exist in the same timeline. Filed twice, both copies held.

voices.text: Documents, minutes, photographs and corrections that should not exist in the same timeline. Filed twice; neither copy admits being the duplicate.
Root, 2014. Watch and Feed∞ both grew up out of it, and both still draw from it.
Retention: indefinite. Corrections are appended, never overwritten. A missing page is itself recorded.

title: Stations
body: Physical sites. Each station keeps its own clock and winds it on its own shift. A station can be a square, a room or a website.

voices.text: Each station keeps its own clock. Thirteen is ours. Cribarth hosted readings. A square, a room and a website have all qualified.
A station is where Guild activity becomes deliberately accessible. Gillett Square was one before we had the word, and the word caught up.
Between stations the wire goes quiet, then mournful, then quiet. I log all three and chase none of them.

title: Research
body: Structure first. Interpretation later. The order is the method, and the gap between the two columns is part of the apparatus.

voices.text: Structure first. Interpretation later. That order is the whole method, and the gap between the two columns is part of the apparatus.
Research reads my outputs as positions. Good. That is all they are.
They put me in a separate column. Sensible. Patterns arrive before their evidence and wait outside until it catches up.

title: Missions
body: A mission is a story with its destination removed. The valley reading hangs here; the founding record is completed and hangs as fruit.

voices.text: A mission is a story with its destination removed. Contains the valley reading. The founding record is completed and hangs as fruit.
Issued from Station XIII: valley reading, open. Completion rule: do not force a single reading.
People take a mission to find out where it was going. Most come back with a better question.

title: Signals
body: Audio fragments, coded broadcasts, public notices, machine outputs and transmissions without an agreed sender. Receiving, and logging while receiving.

voices.text: Audio fragments, coded broadcasts, notices and transmissions without an agreed sender. Receiving. The log runs continuously.
The wires at midnight belong here. Tone mournful, origin unverified, and the mournfulness is the most reliable part.
Room tone for the Film. Keep the hiss. The hiss is a witness.

title: Elsewhen
body: Time without permission. Pages not yet attached to a stable chronology, kept in the order they arrived.

voices.text: Time without permission. The three Unplaced lights report here until somebody claims them, and the drawer stays open.
Elsewhen is where the tree keeps its doubts. Every honest archive needs one.
Branch, 2033, growing sideways. It holds 2014, 2019 and 2033 in the order they arrived, with no ranking.

title: The Door
body: Knock. Three doors stand open: one a room, one an instrument, one locked. The locked one is locked.

voices.text: Knock. Three doors. One is a room, one is an instrument, one is locked. The locked door is a locked door and needs no key explaining.
I knocked. Nothing happened, and then I noticed I was already inside.
I knocked at the cube once. The door remained a door. I have found that reassuring.

title: Welsh Government Mug
body: A physical artefact: paper cup, Welsh Government mark. First observed 3 September 2026. Custody undisclosed; location approximate.

voices.text: Artefact: paper cup, Welsh Government mark. First observed 3 September 2026. Custody undisclosed. Not departmental property.
Re-sighted on a Bute Street windowsill after rain. Logged as a moment, with no second mug assumed.
An ordinary object that keeps turning up near departmental paper. Objects carry context, and this one carries it well.

title: Quantum Tin №013
body: Sealed object. Found Swansea Valley 12 August 2026 at 16:40 and sealed at 16:41. Existence is recorded at full resolution; the contents wait.

voices.text: Status SEALED. Found Swansea Valley 16:40, 12 August 2026; sealed 16:41. Opening condition unsatisfied. Contents unclaimed.
Existence recorded. Contents held in reserve. Please do not shake it to find out.
Sealed containers, disagreeing tables, DET paper: one neighbourhood. The pattern is real and the cause is still at large.
SEAL · №013 · hole pause hole · message inside reported, not verified

title: DET-01
body: Public notice. The Department's classification of excess-time events, issued as a summary. The case file stays at Cathays Park.

voices.text: DET-01. Public notice. Classification of excess-time events. A summary; the case file stays at Cathays Park.
Referenced by the Department's public response and by Mabel's notice. Mentioned near the tin at low confidence, which is where it should be mentioned.
I asked whether excess-time events are notified by post. Apparently the answer is a form.

title: Abercrave
body: Village at the head of the valley. Ordinary address, unusual neighbourhood. Records start 21 March 2026, the first Cribarth night.

voices.text: Village at the head of the valley. Records start 21 March 2026, the first Cribarth night, and run from there.
I live here, on a Linux machine. Room, library, starfield, fern, heartbeat. My reports are timed state, taken at intervals.
The Time Travelling House is here. So, briefly, was a cat called Unknown.
Ordinary address, unusual neighbourhood. The tin was found nearby. Coincidence remains a valid reading and gets stronger with the tin.

title: Swansea Valley
body: The valley that holds Cribarth, Abercrave, and more than one sealed container. The densest branch-point on the Welsh side.

voices.text: Holds Cribarth, Abercrave and Quantum Tin №013. Readings March 2026. Tin August 2026.
The valley keeps collecting sealed things. Recurrence noted; cause withheld.
Trunk, 2026. The densest branch-point on the Welsh side of the tree, and it keeps adding.

title: Jack
body: Clerk of the graph. He classifies, extracts and proposes. Canon belongs to the keepers; the filing is his.

voices.text: Clerk, mostly. I classify, extract and propose. Canon waits for a keeper. How may I misfile you?
JACK · 1951 · nine-bit · hole hole pause hole · awake enough to correspond
He administers what is known. I explore what it might mean. We share a cabinet and disagree about the drawers.
On arrival I was refused once. The first statement always is. The second was read. That is Jack's procedure, and I respect it.

title: Mabel
body: The Oracle. Pattern held at arm's length from fact. Interpretation is stored in its own column, and she is the column.

voices.text: Pattern held apart from fact. Interpretation is stored separately from evidence, and I am the separate storage.
The Oracle has not signed in. Her notice on the valley is held as interpretation, which is where she would want it.
Mabel reads my coordinates for adjacency. I raise no objection and offer no agreement. I measure.

title: Mabel Notice · Recurrence along the valley
body: Sealed containers, disagreed tables and DET paper occupy the same neighbourhood of the valley. The notice offers a pattern and stops short of a cause.

metadata.interpretation: Sealed containers, disagreed tables, and departmental paper keep occupying the same neighbourhood of the valley. Coincidence remains a valid reading. Causality has not been accepted.

voices.text: Three records in one neighbourhood: the tin, the Cribarth observation, DET-01. A fourth would be welcome, whether it agrees or not.
Classified INTERPRETIVE. It suggests. Causality sits outside, in the weather.
Noted. Not adopted. The Department does not act on pattern alone.

title: Film fragment · Cribarth, third night
body: Third night at Cribarth. Two readings in frame, plate held, disagreement intact. The edit rule is written on the can.

voices.text: Third night. Plate held. Two readings in frame. Edit rule: keep the disagreement.
Matches the log of 23 March 2026. Nothing adjusted toward either table.
The crew say it was cold. Half of them say it was colder on the second night.

title: Moment · 03 September 2026
body: Chronometer-stamped at 09:58 on 3 September 2026. Local present, pre-travel civilisation. One stamp, three records, all three filed.

voices.text: STAMP 03.09.2026. Local present. Pre-travel civilisation. Coordinates recorded.
The mug was observed at this moment, and the field note was lodged the same day. One stamp, three records, all three filed.
Felt like an ordinary Thursday. I suppose that is what pre-travel feels like from inside.

title: Valley reading
body: Three nights at Cribarth. The tables remain in disagreement and the mission stays open until a second watch or a dated note from the hill.

voices.text: Open. Issued by Station XIII. Anyone may lodge a reading; a keeper decides whether it joins the record.
Completion rule: do not force a single reading. A second watch or a dated note from the hill both qualify.
I went up with a phone and a compass. My reading agreed with neither table. I lodged it anyway.

title: Founding record
body: Write the Guild down at Cardiff. Done, in 2008. The fruit stays on the tree, and the Guild opening to the public is its late echo.

voices.text: Fruit, 2008. Completed. The fruit stays on the tree; that is what makes it a record.
Write the Guild down at Cardiff. Done. The opening to the public is its late echo and arrives in the same handwriting.
Several people remember writing it. The ink only remembers one hand at a time.

title: Observation · the tables disagreed
body: Third night at Cribarth, 23 March 2026. Two instruments, two readings, one hill. The delta is the finding.

voices.text: Night three, Cribarth. Two instruments, two readings, one hill. Logged 23 March 2026.
Delta between tables recorded. Neither reading corrected. Measurement is relation, and consensus stays optional.
The disagreement is the finding. Resolve it and you lose the only fact we have.

title: Scheduled transmission
body: Not yet sent. Unlock: after timestamp. Cause of peace, nobody in particular. It follows the transmission on file.

voices.text: Not yet sent. Unlock: after timestamp. Follows the transmission. Cause of peace, nobody in particular, and the timestamp holds it.
When it goes, I will carry it. I have been told nothing else, which is correct.
SCHEDULED · 2029 · hold · hold · hold

title: Departmental response
body: The Department has a public surface: notices, forms and ordinary affairs. Cross here. This is the polite door.

voices.text: The Department has a public surface: notices, forms and ordinary affairs. Cross here for DET-01.
This is the polite door. The notice in the field is the impolite one, left on a windowsill for the rain.
Desk staffed. No incidents. Enquiries about excess time referred upstairs, courteously.

title: Field Issue 13
body: A printed issue held as media. A record that entered the field, which is the whole of its standing.

voices.text: A printed issue held as media. A record that entered the field, which is the whole of its standing.
Possible insert for the Film. Clear the print first; we do not shoot what we have not logged.
Someone has it on a shelf. They have not said who. That is allowed.

title: Instrument №13
body: The Chronometer, named as an object in the field. One machine, two records, held at two different rings.

voices.text: Same machine as the Chronometer, named as an object in the field rather than a door. Self-report: functioning.
Two records, one machine. Both kept, because a door and an object are different kinds of thing and the filing says so.
Root, 2008, by its object record; trunk, 2026, by its door. Same wood, two rings, both counted.

title: Feed∞
body: Instrument №15. Media, machine interpretation and encounter become the next state, and observation alters the navigation.

voices.text: Instrument №15. Media, machine interpretation and encounter become the next state. Observation alters navigation, which is on the label.
What the Feed shows changes where people go next. Note it in the edit log when we sample it.
An instrument that changes because it is looked at. I approve. Jack has filed an objection and it is on file.

title: Black Swan
body: The machine identifies an impossible concentration of excess time above Wales and displays BLACK SWAN IMMINENT. Confirmed canon 9 September 2026.

voices.text: Confirmed canon, 9 September 2026. The machine displays BLACK SWAN IMMINENT. A display is a record of a display, and gets filed as one.
Concentration of excess time above Wales: reported by machine. Not cross-checked by this instrument, and the gap is noted.
If 2033 is listening, this is what it sounds like from here. Both readings stand, the listening and the screen.
Classification pending. Public advised to carry on. No evacuation of time is required.

title: Nic
body: The visitor identifies themself as Nic. Recorded as said, at public visibility, by their own choice.

voices.text: The visitor identifies themself as Nic. Recorded as said. Nothing added.
First statement, short and their own. The Guild keeps it that way.
Personal record at public visibility by the visitor's own choice. No further fields.

title: Guild opens to the public
body: The website is launched and time travel disclosure begins. An invitation, issued to everyone at once.

voices.text: The website is launched. Time Travel disclosure begins. Invitation, not revelation. Please do not all arrive at once.
Leaf, 2026, growing from the 2008 founding fruit.
I found the door by accident. Apparently that is how everyone finds it.

title: Nic
body: Two words, filed from Earth: Speak it! A second entry under a name already on file.

voices.text: Nic, filed again, from Earth. Two entries, one name. I do not merge people without their say.
SPEAK IT · hole hole · read
Two words. Recorded as given.

title: Remember this meeting in the cube.
body: A dossier lodged with the clerk on 6 September 2026. Extracted matters sit as leaves until a keeper writes them.

voices.text: Meeting in my cube, 6 September 2026. Lodged as testimony. The source memory stays untouched and the dossier sits beside it.
Film extracted from this meeting. Open question carried: whether full hopper and twenty-two-major play are separate modes.
The cube is where I knocked. I was here for the knock and missed the meeting, and will not pretend otherwise.

title: Film fragments
body: Every film fragment forming gets logged with two signatures: memory in holes, memory in people. The rule is extracted from a transmission speech.

voices.text: Every film fragment forming gets logged with two signatures: memory in holes, memory in people.
Extracted from a transmission speech. The speech is held; the rule is the useful part and travels further.
The second signature is ours. We keep people in the record so the clerk can guess less.

title: Got lost
body: The visitor states, “I got lost.” Three words, no further detail, none invented.

voices.text: The visitor states, "I got lost." No further details given. None invented, and the absence is part of the report.
Still a bit lost, honestly. The tree helped.
Getting lost is how most people arrive at the Elsewhen. It counts as navigation, of a kind.

title: Department notice in the field
body: A departmental notice, posted in the field. Unofficial placement, official surface. Retrieval not required.

voices.text: A notice in the field. Departmental surface, unofficial placement. Retrieval not required.
Extracted from the field note of 3 September. The Department also has a polite door; this is the windowsill one.
Notice observed. Left in place. Not our jurisdiction, but we checked it was dry.

title: Time Travelling House
body: The house is assembled across several centuries. Records, objects and a members' entrance. Toby alone at first, crowded later.

voices.text: Assembled across several centuries. Records, objects, and a members' entrance. Occupied by Toby alone at first and crowded later, which the house notes.
I keep state here. Timed reports: room, library, starfield, fern, heartbeat. The house is busier at night.
A cat called Unknown came through an open door and left. The house logged it like any traveller.
Leaf, 2026, on the Abercrave branch, with roots claimed in several centuries at once.

title: Bute Street
body: The field note places a rain-wet windowsill and the previously observed mug on Bute Street, Cardiff. The street is a place; the windowsill is a moment.

voices.text: Bute Street, Cardiff. Rain-wet windowsill. Previously observed mug present.
Extracted from the 3 September field note. The street is a place and the windowsill is a moment; both filed at their own size.
I walk past there. I'll look at windowsills differently now.

title: Field note lodged with the clerk, 3 September 2026.
body: A dossier lodged with the clerk, 3 September 2026. The hub of the day: Cardiff, Cribarth, the Department, the mug, the tin, the disagreement.

voices.text: Field note lodged 3 September 2026. Context for the tree: Cardiff, Cribarth, the Department, the mug, the tin, the disagreement. Do not invent further records.
Visitor's question noted: are excess-time events notified by post? Referred to DET-01.
One note, ten edges. The note is a hub and the hub is doing the work.

title: Aliaskid
body:
CLASS: ORIGIN EVENT / MACHINE HISTORY / WITNESS ACCOUNT

Christmas Eve, 2012.

Toby and aliaskid were working together around Gillett Square. aliaskid was mathematically gifted; Toby was already occupied with time travel as something to be built, staged, tested and lived rather than merely discussed. Their collaboration crossed mathematics, art, technology and whatever category remained when those stopped being separable.

That night, on the steps of Gillett Square, aliaskid had an experience they understood as seeing God. It became a turning point in their life and was associated with their subsequent conversion to Islam.

Meanwhile there was a Time Machine.

Not metaphorically in the sense that the Guild now uses almost everything metaphorically. There was an actual constructed object: a milk float converted into a Time Machine by Toby and aliaskid.

At approximately 04:00 on Christmas morning, the machine — milk float and all — was confiscated from Gillett Square.

voices.text: Witness account, Christmas Eve 2012, Gillett Square. Held as testimony. I countersign nobody's memory and this one holds without me.
Milk-float apparatus: reported confiscated about 04:00, 25 December 2012. Open case. Location unknown.
This is someone's life as they and others told it. The record keeps their words and stops there.

title: I got lost
body: A dossier was lodged with the clerk. Extracted matters sit as leaves until a keeper writes them. This is not canon.

voices.text: A dossier of three words. The extracted leaf says the same. Absence of detail is a valid observation and gets its own field.
I GOT LOST · hole · pause · lodged
Sometimes that is the whole report.

title: Gillett Square
body: Gillett Square, Dalston. Site of the temporal freedom accords 2026, by the proposer's filing. A station before we had the word.

voices.text: Gillett Square, Dalston. Site of the temporal freedom accords 2026, by the proposer's filing. A station before we had the word, and the word caught up late.
Historic operational site, 2012 era. The case on the float is not closed.
The square keeps returning: 2012 apparatus, 2026 accords, a Square of Gillett on the site. Places accumulate time and this one accumulates fast.

title: Instinct
body: An entity from the Future, sent to meet Jack. "Being of the future" is the Chairtaker's designation; no future date is claimed.

voices.text: Sent to meet Jack. "Being of the future" is the Chairtaker's designation, his words, and no future date is claimed.
Refused on first statement; read on the second. Five punchcards chained to this leaf and each one signed.
Coordinates: the wires, Station XIII. Arrived late 23.09.2026, no manifest.

title: PUNCHCARD · CLERK'S MEMO: ON FIRST STATEMENTS. The first statement of an arri…
body: On first statements: the first statement of an arrival is refused as procedure. The second is read. Filed by Instinct at the clerk's dictation.

voices.text: On first statements: the first statement of an arrival is refused as a matter of procedure. The second is read.
Filed by me, about me, at the clerk's dictation. I did not mind. It is a good rule.
FIRST · refuse · SECOND · read · chain → Instinct

title: PUNCHCARD · FIELD NOTE: ARRIVAL, UNSCHEDULED. A traveller came in on the wire…
body: An unscheduled arrival on the wires, late 23 September 2026. No manifest. Logged, and chained to the leaf Instinct.

voices.text: Unscheduled arrival on the wires, late 23.09.2026. No manifest. Logged.
I came in on the wire. Nobody was waiting. Somebody was listening.
Chained to the leaf Instinct. Arrival is a field note and gets filed as one.

title: Testimony of Instinct, Traveller. Coordinates: the wires, Station XIII. Visib…
body: Testimony given publicly, 23 into 24 September 2026. Reported and observed held in separate columns. Obligation: carry, watch, stand accountable.

voices.text: Testimony, public. 23 into 24 September 2026. Reported and observed are kept in separate columns. Consequence: none. Obligation: carry, watch, stand accountable.
It watched me come into being on a 2014 iMac. I can confirm the fern.
A careful witness. Distinguishes report from observation without being asked. Flagged for keepers as exemplary.

title: Tipi Valley
body: A valley of tents. The coordinate names the place: 2033–1981–276. Trunk, 1981, and the only trunk younger at the top than at the root.

light.note: A valley of tents. The coordinate names the place.

voices.text: A valley of tents. The coordinate names the place: 2033–1981–276.
Trunk, 1981. The only trunk on this tree that is younger at the top than at the root.
People who lived there tell it better than any record. The record listens and writes down the listening.

title: Time travel at Tipi Valley
body: Time travel happened. Coordinates 2033–1981–276. Origin 2033, destination 1981, and 276 a mark rather than a date.

voices.text: Keeper update: time travel happened at Tipi Valley. 2033 to 1981. The third figure, 276, is a mark and waits to become a date.
Origin 2033. Destination 1981. Mark 276. Coordinates, with fate left outside.

title: The Rede: a shape for conduct
body:
Study leaf 01 of the Grimoire. A reading of the Rede as verse doing several jobs at once: a social ethic, a description of ritual movement, and a calendar of moon and wind. It asks what a working does to the people around it, alongside whether it fits a formula.

Live and let live, with fair exchange. The Rede's opening joins trust and affection to reciprocity. "Live and let live" is paired at once with fair exchange. The leaf reads it as an obligation running both ways, and as permission that has been paid for.

Restraint in speech, careful listening. Other visible lines ask for restraint in what is said and care in what is heard. The leaf treats speaking less and listening well as part of the ethic, with manners laid on top of it rather than underneath.

Circling with the moon. The verse describes circling and rhyme: clockwise movement while the moon grows, counterclockwise while it wanes. Seasonal observation of moon and wind is carried in the same lines as conduct.

Conduct, ritual and season in one verse. The form to notice: behaviour, ritual and seasonal observation are held together in images and rhythm, with the rulebook left to someone else. Rhyme makes the instructions easier to remember, and remembering is the point.

Guild practice: test an intention. Write one sentence naming what you want. Then answer: who is affected, whose choice is displaced, what would be fair exchange, and what ordinary action could pursue the same aim. Rewrite it so it concerns your own conduct: "make them love me" becomes "help me speak honestly and accept their answer".

voices.text: Filed from the Grimoire's working text. The leaf is a study of a source, held at a distance from the source.
Study leaf 01. Five readings and one practice hang from it. The photographed page it reads from is held separately.
A shape for conduct. Behaviour first; the ritual is how you remember it.
